sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 400. Physical damage (Time).
Ability Power boosted by 100 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 400. Magic damage (Time).
Ability Power boosted by 100 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: yourself. Applies hero for 60 seconds (increases max HP and all stats by 100%; nullifies debuffs, status ailments, and Unison gauge reduction; nullifies buffs [Demerit]; reduces healing effects received by 70% [Demerit]).
Reduces star Unison Attack and Great Spirit Unison Attack damage by 50% when equipped in the main slot.
